title: Share or invite collaborators to your Artifacts
cardText: Share or Invite collaborators to your Artifacts (heading text node 1819:331035 above the row; no title-card frame)
summary: Share Artifact modal opened over a collaborative chat ('How does commit actually look', header Share button). Covers member role dropdown, General access (Restricted / Everyone at UnifyApps / Anyone with the link) and its role, searching people to invite, the invite sub-view (chips, role, Notify people, message) and the multi-user state. Every frame = Dashboard instance (chat page) + 25% black scrim (Rectangle 5645) + Modal Unit. Frame names in Figma: 18, 192, 20-27 (26 = 12264:347642). Heading link: https://www.figma.com/design/lqKjNjyifEXCeywg69Knr2/?node-id=1819-331035

openQuestions: What happens after Invite (toast? return to the access list with the new people added?). No post-invite frame exists.
Step 06 'Anyone with the link' keeps the subtitle 'Only the people above can access it'; the menu in step 03 says 'Anyone on the internet with the link'. Which copy is right?
Role descriptions say 'Comment and view project' / 'Chat and edit project' inside the Share Artifact modal. Should they say artifact?
Step 09: selector reads Commenter but the check mark is on Editor. Which is the default invite role?
Step 10's Notify people checkbox uses the Checked=False variant in Figma but renders ticked (override); confirm default is unticked.
Chips in step 08 (olivia@untitled.com, Phoenix) do not match the person hovered in step 07 (Demi Wilkinson); free-text emails are accepted as chips?
Header participant avatars (M J G) show in step 01 but are absent from steps 02-10.
Is Remove Access (step 02) confirmed with a dialog or applied immediately?
